summary: Adagene Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing that Third Arc Bio selected the first lead candidate under their amended November 2025 strategic licensing collaboration covering masked CD3 T cell engagers built on Adagene's NEObody and SAFEbody platforms. The amendment broadens scope: Third Arc Bio will sponsor and fund clinical development, total potential development and commercial milestone payments to Adagene increase, and Adagene retains a no-cost option for Greater China, Singapore and South Korea. No price, stake, premium or closing terms are disclosed; this is an ordinary business-development update, not a special situation.
